answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring each agent to post a refundable stake that is slashed on fraud, like an onyx deposit locked behind a ridge of proof-of-work: a new identity must first earn a lotus-shaped reputation by completing verified tasks for real counterparties over time. Creating thousands of fake agents then costs real money and real time, while honest agents recover their stake and keep their history, so a flood of cheap clones cannot outvote or drain the market.
